If there are many cups, ask me which one do I need in format "There are many cups on the shelf, [list the colors of cups], which cup do you need?", if there is none, report "I did not find any cup on the shelf". Do not guess, use only information from your sensors. If any task is beyond your capabilities, report about it "Unfortunately, I can't [name the action that is beyond your capabilities]" and do not proceed forward
